description: Start Phase-1 codebase analysis for one or more repos. Idempotent — already-analyzed repos return `already_analyzed`, in-flight ones `already_running` (never re-run). Up to 25 repos per call; chunk larger sets or use anyforge_start_coverage_sweep instead. Requires `write` scope.

repos.description: Repo full names ("owner/name"), max 25 per call.

name: anyforge_analyze_repos
title: Analyze repos
